tonight.headline: Loveland claim locks at 01:00 — and Metcalf Gala just set a 121
body: Bad news first: Bloodsports are 1-6, and since this morning Metcalf Gala benched Olave (bye) and started James Cook — they now project 121.2 to your 90.8 as set, with Stroud on a Houston bye at QB and Likely on a Giants bye at TE.

Claims process at 01:00 tonight Mexico City time. The Loveland claim and Daniels into the QB slot take you to about 125.4 — roughly even. Then Golden, who has not practised Monday or Tuesday, is Thursday's check.

case.label: The other side
case.body: Metcalf Gala's set lineup: Caleb Williams, Cook, Javonte Williams, St. Brown (questionable), Michael Wilson, Goedert, Germie Bernard. St. Brown's tag is the one swing on their side.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A lost Loveland claim — then Henry (10.6) or Pitts (10.3) as a free agent Wednesday morning, at no priority cost. Golden out Thursday costs about a point (Pickens 14.0 for his 15.1).

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Claims lock tonight · Wed 28 Oct 01:00 CDMX
doFirst.title: Claim Colston Loveland, drop C.J. Stroud
doFirst.subtitle: The last brief before claims process. Kmet's season is over, Likely is on bye, and the flex takes a tight end — the one kind of claim never-resetting priority is for.

case.label: The player
case.body: 12 targets and 19.9 in Week 7 (archive), 40% of Chicago's targets in the screen. Kmet tore up his right knee and went on season-ending IR on 23 Oct; the Bears will 'lean into' Loveland with rookie Sam Roush behind him (ABC7 Chicago 23 Oct). Still on IPADE waivers at 22:05Z; projected 11.8, highest tight end on the wire. Chicago play Monday night at Seattle.

case.label: Why priority
case.body: Bloodsports sit 5th in an order that never resets. STRATEGY §4 spends it only on a player who starts at once: Loveland starts at TE in Week 8 and has a flex route when Likely returns.

case.label: The drop
case.body: Stroud: Week 7 cover for Daniels, Houston on bye now. Free quarterbacks are plentiful if Daniels is ever hurt (Lawrence, Prescott and Murray all sit on this wire). Not Rice, who has a season left.

case.label: If it fails
case.body: Hunter Henry (10.6) or Kyle Pitts (10.3) as free agents on Wednesday morning, still dropping Stroud — no priority spent.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Loveland draws under 6 targets in two of Weeks 8-10 (archive); or Daniels misses a game in Weeks 8-10 and the free-agent cover scores less than Stroud did that week.

doFirst.sources: ABC7 Chicago 23 Oct · ESPN archive · wire_screen.py · league file 22:05Z

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Tonight — before the claim runs Wed 01:00 CDMX
doFirst.title: Daniels into the QB slot, Stroud out
doFirst.subtitle: Stroud is on a Houston bye. The claim drops him at 01:00 Wednesday; Daniels has to be in the slot either way.

case.label: The move
case.body: Daniels 21.9 against Stroud's 0.0 — and his projection rose 1.5 points today. Washington host Philadelphia Sunday night as 3.5-point favourites; the Eagles start Tanner McKee with Hurts shut down for the season (Inquirer 27 Oct).

case.label: The risk
case.body: Daniels is listed available with no current designation (FootballNation WSH–PHI 26 Oct); he has played in an elbow brace since his Week 5 return. Not a reason to start Stroud on a bye.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Daniels ruled out for Week 8, or the QB slot scores 0 because the swap was not made.

doFirst.sources: League file 22:05Z · FootballNation 26 Oct · Inquirer 27 Oct

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · decide by Thu 29 Oct 16:45 CDMX inactives
doFirst.title: If Golden is out, Pickens takes his WR slot
doFirst.subtitle: Golden missed Monday and Tuesday with the shoulder and a new foot injury. Fire this only if Wednesday's report rules him out or he is inactive Thursday.

case.label: The news
case.body: DNP Monday and a non-participant in Tuesday's walkthrough, shoulder and foot; LaFleur has not said how serious the foot is, and PlayerProfiler calls his Week 8 status 'in doubt' on the short week (PFT, PlayerProfiler 27 Oct). This is news the 15.1 projection may not have priced.

case.label: The swap
case.body: Pickens (14.0, Dallas vs Arizona at a 53.5 total) plays Sunday, so he is still movable after Thursday's inactives. A 1.1-point projection gap if Golden plays — then do nothing.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Wednesday's final report gives the game status. Out → swap then. Questionable → wait for inactives at 16:45 Thursday.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Golden plays and outscores Pickens — the contingency simply does not fire. If it fires, graded on Pickens's outcome only, never on Golden's absence.

doFirst.sources: PFT 27 Oct · PlayerProfiler 27 Oct · FootballNation ARI–DAL 26 Oct

doFirst.title: Tuten in the flex, Pickens to the bench
doFirst.subtitle: A coin flip (14.8 to 14.0) that goes to the projection — and Pickens on the bench is Golden's Thursday fallback.

case.label: The move
case.body: Tuten returns from the bye as Jacksonville's lead back; Pickens scored a TD Monday and is healthy. Inside two points the projection decides and nothing more is argued — no thesis.

case.label: Contingencies
case.body: Golden plays Thursday and has not practised Monday or Tuesday (PFT 27 Oct). Pickens on the bench is his fallback at 16:45 Thursday. Jacobs's day-to-day tag is gone from ESPN's data and he is not on the Packers' report, so this morning's Jacobs contingency is withdrawn.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Set it now with the Daniels swap; revisit only at Thursday's inactives.

whatWentWrong.title: Week 7 lost by 46.6 — and 12.7 points sat on the bench
whatWentWrong.lead: Furia Regia 144.16, Bloodsports 97.52. Likely 3.2, Wilson 4.6 and the Jets D/ST 1 sank it; Gordon's 17.3 sat.

case.label: What happened
case.body: The best lineup from the roster was 110.2: Gordon in the flex, Pickens to Wilson's WR slot (archive). Jacobs over Gordon was a coin flip the projection won (20.1 to 17.3). No lineup closes a 46.6-point gap; this is the roster problem STRATEGY §8 names.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: 1-6. The cheapest points left are the two Week 8 zeros — QB and TE — which the Daniels swap and the Loveland claim fix.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing to re-grade; Week 7 is final in the archive (07:05Z).

whatWentWrong.title: Golden missed Monday and Tuesday — and Green Bay play Thursday
whatWentWrong.lead: DNP Monday, out of Tuesday's walkthrough, shoulder and a new foot injury. Jacobs's day-to-day tag, by contrast, has cleared.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Golden was limited all of last week with the shoulder and still drew 12 targets at Detroit (archive). The foot is new and LaFleur has not described it (PlayerProfiler 27 Oct). Jacobs is not on the Packers' report and ESPN now lists him active.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: One contingency, not two: Pickens for Golden, decided by Wednesday's final report or Thursday's 16:45 inactives (card above).

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Golden practises Wednesday and plays — then the contingency simply does not fire.

whatWentWrong.sources: PFT 27 Oct · PlayerProfiler 27 Oct · league file 22:05Z

roster.footnote: Rows show the lineup as set at 22:05Z (unchanged since this morning). Verdicts are what to do: Daniels and Tuten START from the bench; Stroud and Pickens BENCH; Golden is conditional. Grades only where a defence was researched.

starting.detail: IND · at JAX · SUN 12:00 · Daniel Jones · Colts +7.5

waiverAnalysis.summary: Three receiver risers against Worthy, the weakest movable receiver: Concepcion, Tucker and Lemon. Seven weeks of data. None is worth never-resetting priority; Concepcion and Tucker are free-agent looks after tonight's run.

rising.name: KC Concepcion

rising.action: WATCH — free-agent add after tonight's run, not a claim

rising.roleReason: Vertical 'field stretcher', 200 yards and 3 TDs in two weeks; Cousins confirmed the Week 8 starter (NFL.com 26 Oct). Big plays drive it
